final_name.description:
South West of Wapiti there is a farm near Window Rock that grows ALASKAN Ginseng.
That should get you four, then head NE past the tower and follow the rock face for another plant.

final_name.description: The bootshaped pond to the left of the word Bayou on the map, south west of Lagras has them in. The special swamp lure works well, they are massive fish with a long thin snout.

final_name.text: Multiple Player kills in 5 sec. in Free Roam Events
final_name.description:
Fools Gold, Railroad Baron, Cold Dead Hands, and King Of The Castle are good choices for this.
Maybe a well aimed dynamite arrow at the Railroad Baron spawn area is the best way to get them in a single shot.
